item.title: Version 1.1.13
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.13

  • Menu Bar Portfolio Table Upgrade: Pinned the Symbol column and enabled 2D horizontal scrolling across all customized Desktop Portfolio columns with synchronized row hover highlights.
  • Sortable Columns & Rich Context Menu: Added clickable column header sorting synced with the Desktop window, Buy Target (🎯 MUA) indicators, and full right-click actions (Watchlist, Portfolio, Price Alert, Buy Target, Close/Sell, Delete).
  • Cleaner Metrics & Faster Actions: Removed duplicate percentage display under Today PnL and streamlined symbol removal in the Menu Bar popover without confirmation dialogs.
